name: @oravio/auth
comment: Never installed by an app. Authored source vendored into every app/* by scripts/sync-ui.mjs, so every app stays a flat, standalone Vite project that can be dropped into Lovable directly (same as M5). LoginCard.tsx imports @/components/ui/* and AuthCallback.tsx imports @/components/oravio/* from packages/ui — tsconfig.json redirects both aliases to ../ui/src so `typecheck` here is a real check, not just a stand-in for a synced app's.
